content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm unable to connect a user-defined function (UDF) digital output to the ON/OFF parameter in a [product_name] text message. I can insert other UDF parameters, like timer values, but not the digital output. Does anyone have suggestions or can try this?
That's not possible. As an alternative, you could link a flag to the UDF output and then display the status of that flag in your message text.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a limitation trying to display the ON/OFF state of a UDF digital output in [product_name] text messages, while other UDF parameters such as timer values are supported. The inability to directly add digital outputs restricts message customization based on user-defined logic.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to directly link and show the ON/OFF status of a UDF digital output in [product_name] text messages, similar to timer values.
